drive.newline_normalization: CRLF to LF for provenance identity only; numeric values unchanged
drive.interpolation: bounded piecewise linear; original knots and required40/60ns included; no padding/clamping
drive.clock_scenario: Preserve unshifted published C.19 time. Assume it is comparable to the published ALEGRA clock; this registration is unverified.
drive.initial_state_scenario: At the first supported trace knot, initialize uniform DC conductor currents +/-I0, solve the static magnetic A_z field, and set temperature to300K. Prehistory and deposited heat before this timestamp are unknown, not reconstructed.

mfem_snapshot_metadata.model: MFEM H1 A_z MQS with sigma0 vacuum, two independent conductor gradients constrained by a2x2 current Schur complement; separate conductor-only insulated thermal FE
mfem_snapshot_metadata.material_provenance: Explicit constant illustrative conductivity/heat capacity/thermal conductivity; not a fitted or qualified SS304 property model. No phase change or temperature feedback.

mfem_field_contrast.current_convention: width-weighted mean absolute current density, not a fit to the unverified published J axis

sampling_convention: MFEM cell averages read as a P0 reconstruction; half-open right/deeper cell owns interior ties. No spatial/temporal interpolation or extrapolation.
edge_location_policy: Published precise transverse edge-lineout offset is unavailable. Nearest resolved edge-cell mean and a declared outer-band sensitivity are conditional choices, not matched physical probes.
